summary: Phase E tested end-to-end. New suite /app/backend/tests/test_phase_e.py = 27/27 passing (threaded post comments CRUD + validation + notifications, and scheduler._nightly_job 24h review-reminder path incl. idempotency). Phase A/B/C/D regression re-run: 132/132 passing. Frontend verified on the public preview URL: Feed allow_comments checkbox + threaded comments panel (create/reply/indent/delete/cascade/comments-off), CrewBankModal portal wrapper (mounted at document.body, Escape/backdrop/close, content click safe, join flow), and mobile hamburger drawer at 390x844. ONE CRITICAL UI defect found: the mobile drawer's `fixed inset-0` is clipped to the 64px header box because the <header> uses backdrop-blur-xl (backdrop-filter creates a containing block) — backdrop is 390x64, drawer 288x64, so backdrop-click-to-close does not work below the header and drawer links overlap/tap-through page content.

minor.issue: Returns 200 [] for a non-existent post id (no existence check). Harmless but inconsistent with POST which 404s; also unauthenticated read of comments on any post is allowed by design.

Cascade is one level only (delete_many on parent_id == deleted id). Grandchild replies are orphaned and, because PostComments.jsx only renders childrenOf() at depth 0, orphaned depth-2 comments become invisible in the UI while still stored. Matches the documented design, flagging for awareness.

No rate limiting / no de-dupe: the same body can be posted repeatedly. Also no index on comments.post_id / comments.parent_id — list is a collection scan capped at 500 docs, and >500 comments silently truncates the thread.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: drawer + backdrop are rendered inside <header class='sticky ... backdrop-blur-xl'>. backdrop-filter makes the header a containing block for position:fixed, so `fixed inset-0` resolves to the header box. Measured: mobile-drawer-backdrop = 390x64, mobile-drawer = 288x64 (should be full viewport / inset-y-0). Consequences: (1) backdrop click below y=64 does NOT close the drawer (verified fail), (2) the drawer's nav list and market-selector footer overflow the 64px white panel and float over the page with no white background, (3) document.elementFromPoint at the centre of mobile-nav-reviews returns the underlying page button (filter-volunteer_opportunity), i.e. real taps can hit page content instead of the nav link. Fix: render the drawer with createPortal(document.body) exactly like components/Modal.jsx does, or move the drawer markup outside <header>.

testid contract change: the close button is now `crewbank-modal-close` (derived from Modal's `${testId}-close`); the requested/legacy `crewbank-close` no longer exists anywhere in the codebase. Either pass a closeTestId or update the spec/tests.
Redundant duplicate copy for a signed-in user on a comments-off post: 'Comments are turned off on this post.' plus the italic 'The author has turned off new comments.' Show one.

issues: Drawer panel white background is only 64px tall (see critical bug); nav links render on top of page content with no surface behind them.

No comment count on the collapsed toggle until the panel has been opened once (count comes from the lazy load), so 'Show comments' never advertises existing activity — consider returning comment_count with GET /api/posts.

action_items: HIGH: portal the mobile nav drawer to document.body (or move it out of the backdrop-blur-xl <header>) so the backdrop covers the viewport, backdrop click closes, and drawer links are not tap-through.
LOW: restore/alias the `crewbank-close` testid or update automation to `crewbank-modal-close`.
LOW: dedupe the two 'comments are off' messages in PostComments.
OPTIONAL: add mongo indexes on comments.post_id and comments.parent_id; return comment_count in GET /api/posts; paginate beyond the 500-doc cap.
critical_code_review_comments: community_router.create_comment re-queries the parent comment a second time for the notification (already fetched during validation) — reuse the first lookup.

scheduler._nightly_job step 5 sets reminder_sent_at with an unconditional update_one; two overlapping runs could both pass the filter and double-send. Prefer a conditional update ({id, reminder_sent_at: {$in:[None,False]}}) BEFORE sending and only email when modified_count==1.

Verified good: comments exclude _id everywhere, author snapshot fields (name/avatar/account_type) are denormalized at write time, allow_comments=false is enforced server-side (403) not just hidden in the UI, notify de-dupes post-author vs parent-author, delete honours author OR platform_role=admin, and the reminder subject/hours_left are computed from reveal_at with a safe fallback.

Modal.jsx is a correct portal implementation (body scroll lock restored on unmount, stopPropagation on the card, Escape listener) — the Header drawer should reuse it instead of hand-rolling fixed positioning.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% — all comment + CrewBank modal flows pass; mobile drawer geometry/backdrop-close fails

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral only. Backend suite mints TEST_userE_* users/sessions/posts/comments/review-sessions and tears them down in a module fixture. UI testing used /app/tests/ui_seed_iter11.py (2 TEST_uiE_* users, 3 posts, 1 event) and everything was deleted afterwards (verified 0 residual TEST_* users / comments / events). seed_alex.identity_verified=true preserved and asserted.
test_credentials: No app passwords (Emergent Google OAuth). Mint mongo sessions per /app/auth_testing.md; tests use the mint_user helper (platform_role:'admin' is what deps.is_admin checks — there is no is_admin field).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_phase_e.py is xdist-safe (RUN_PREFIX TEST_userE_<worker>_). Key gotchas learned: (1) POST /api/posts requires `type`, not `kind`; (2) admin-ness = users.platform_role=='admin' or email in ADMIN_EMAILS; (3) calling scheduler._nightly_job repeatedly from separate asyncio.run() calls raises 'Event loop is closed' unless you pop scheduler/notifications/mailer/deps/routers.reviews_router from sys.modules before each run so motor rebinds to the new loop (see TestReviewReminder._run_nightly); (4) EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY is unset so mailer.send_email returns {status:'skipped'} — the reminder loop still runs and reminder_sent_at is still set; the test wraps mailer.send_email to capture calls. UI: cookie session_token on nw-sailing-community.preview.emergentagent.com, browser User-Agent required for API curl. Untested: notification bell rendering of kind='comment', comments at >500 volume, and drawer behaviour after the portal fix.
rca_of_the_issue: Mobile drawer: `<header class="sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl">` applies backdrop-filter, which per CSS spec makes the element a containing block for fixed-position descendants. The drawer's `fixed inset-0` therefore resolves to the 64px-tall header box instead of the viewport (measured backdrop 390x64, aside 288x64). Reproduce: 390x844 viewport -> click [data-testid=mobile-menu-btn] -> click at (370,300) -> drawer stays open; bounding_box of the backdrop is 390x64. Mitigation: render the drawer through createPortal(node, document.body) (as components/Modal.jsx already does) or hoist it out of the header element.
